name: miniapp-decoded
description: 用 Web 技术栈还原微信小程序双线程架构：Worker 当 JSCore，iframe 当 WebView，Native 层做消息中转。

scripts.postinstall: echo 'Tip: run `pnpm start` to launch the whole mini-program simulator.'
scripts.clean: rimraf native/public logic/public ui/public components/public components/lib native/apps/douyin/__compiled__ node_modules/.cache
scripts.clean:all: pnpm -r exec rimraf public lib build/output node_modules && rimraf node_modules
scripts.build: pnpm run build:vendor && pnpm run build:components && pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:logic && pnpm run build:native
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n components,ui,logic,native -c magenta,cyan,yellow,green "pnpm --filter components run dev" "pnpm --filter ui_sdk run dev" "pnpm --filter logic_sdk run dev" "pnpm --filter native run dev"
scripts.serve: concurrently -k -n srv-native,srv-ui,srv-logic,srv-components -c blue,cyan,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter native run serve" "pnpm --filter ui_sdk run serve" "pnpm --filter logic_sdk run serve" "pnpm --filter components run serve"
